item.description: Stranger Things star Millie Bobby Brown has confirmed she officially changed her name to Millie Bonnie Bongiovi after marrying Jake Bongiovi in 2024.

item.title: PETA Asks Alice in Chains to Change Band Name to Help Save Circus Elephant
item.description: PETA is seeking the help of grunge legends Alice in Chains to help free an elephant named Betty from the long-running Carden Circus.

item.title: Sean "Diddy" Combs Threatens to Sue Netflix If It Airs New Documentary
item.description: Lawyers for Sean "Diddy" Combs have sent Netflix a cease-and-desist on the eve of premiere of Sean Combs: The Reckoning, a new four-part documentary about the disgraced hip-hop mogul.

item.title: Mt. Joy Announce New North American Tour Dates in 2026
